third_party_assets: Only the existing official CC0 MakeHuman/MPFB mesh, actual bundled morph targets, game_engine weights, skin, eyes, brows, lashes, teeth, tongue, shoes and long01/bob01/ponytail01 hair.
author: MakeHuman Team and contributors for CC0 inputs; new preset recipes and regenerated original garments authored by GitHub Copilot for Jenny's project
new_work: Willow: leaner, more athletic soft-tissue proportions and more defined facial structure
Hazel: softer, fuller soft-tissue proportions and rounder facial structure
Tunic and apron refitted independently to each new body through the existing procedural garment helpers
method: HumanService.create_human, actual TargetService.load_target files and HumanService.add_mhclo_asset; no arbitrary vertex warping to fabricate another face
rig_policy: Fitted anatomical joint endpoint differences were measured first: Willow <=3.262 mm, Hazel <=3.458 mm. Both retain the original unmodified bind skeleton and reuse the existing idle/walk clips.
demographic_scope: Original adult age anchor 0.5 and original race/skin/eye/hair-color choices retained. These are subtle shape alternatives, not demographic or personality assignments.
privacy: No portrait upload, new external download, account, purchase or Unreal/editor/build invocation.
coverage_and_limits: All three existing hairstyles and both existing outfit choices are delivered for each body: twelve complete clothed meshes.
Original tunic coverage and under-clothing body masking are retained. Matching garment geometry was regenerated for each body.
Actual FBX round trips retain 53 authoring bones with zero preferred bind-matrix error; original clips were applied and rendered.
Apron nearest-normal diagnostics flag one possible ~1.8 mm overlap for Willow and two samples up to ~3.1 mm for Hazel in the sampled walk pose. These diagnostics are not a full collision proof.
No cloth/hair physics, facial animation, extreme-pose validation, independent runtime face/body sliders or high-fidelity approval.
New meshes remain offline assets until the parent imports and tests them. This delivery is not a claim that the full appearance MVP is integrated.
